failure_lineage.recovery: Confirmed terminal failure and absence of both reports and primary time file. Replaced the shell-only directive with POSIX set -eu and checked /bin/sh -n; preserved the failed log. Identical frozen CLI, settings, inputs and intended output paths; no previous bootstrap result overwritten and no inference rerun.

multiplicity_scope: Bonferroni percentile-tail adjustment over this one contrast times three metrics only; not a correction for historical tuning, method selection, other uncertainty readouts or all benchmark endpoints.
independent_math: Without calling paired_bootstrap, statistics or weighted_records: order all 70 exact admitted family records by RefOG name; verify TP+FN=n(n-1)/2; independently form TP/FP/FN divided by n-1. Compute observed weighted counts with Fraction arithmetic. Generate 100000 shared multinomial(70,[1/70]*70) multiplicities using numpy.Generator(numpy.PCG64(20261016)); independently compute F1=200TP/(2TP+FP+FN), precision=100TP/(TP+FP), recall=100TP/(TP+FN). Compare candidate-minus-control quantiles at [0.025,0.975] and [0.05/6,1-0.05/6], point differences, and per-family win/tie/loss counts against retained report; every numeric comparison agrees within 1e-12 percentage points. Independent calculation shares the specified NumPy RNG/quantile implementation, not an independent statistical estimator.

Verified frozen helper bytes and Git blobs, unchanged scientific runtime, correct distinct dataset partitions, exactly 70 reference files and all 11 low-certainty files against both cells. resources.scope: Scoring/bootstrap only on shared host, not inference or a speed comparison. GNU-time maximum process RSS is not a simultaneous summed process-tree or cgroup peak.

interpretation: Failed development gate and branch closure remain unchanged. The nominal precision interval excludes zero, but its three-endpoint-adjusted interval and both F1/recall intervals include zero. Do not declare statistically established inferiority, superiority, equivalence, noninferiority or no effect. These development-exposed conditional intervals do not validate arbitrary-dataset generalization.
limitations: Exchangeable-family resampling does not account for shared evolutionary histories or dependence introduced by fused predictions.
Approximate percentile intervals and adjustment provide no guaranteed simultaneous coverage or correction for the optimization history.
No run-to-run, species-sampling, dataset-shift, QfO or Three Kingdoms uncertainty is quantified here. FAS remains unseeded.
The original 0.005 decline heuristic is only a development screen; it is not changed by these intervals.
